run_cfd_training: run the CFD model training loop with exponential decay learning rate and Adam optimizer
run_cloth_training: run the cloth model training loop with world position field and history enabled
run_cfd_evaluation: run CFD model rollout trajectories and save results to a pickle file
run_cloth_evaluation: run cloth model rollout trajectories on the validation split and log scalar metrics
build_encode_process_decode_model: build an EncodeProcessDecode graph network model with configurable latent size and message passing steps
